{{Name|Sugar|1}} }} '''Banana Pudding''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]]. 1-2 Banana Pudding may occasionally be found in [[Supply Crate]]s on the [[Farm Maps#Beach|Beach Farm]] provided the player has upgraded the [[Farmhouse]] at least two times. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |love=Abigail |like=Alex,Caroline,Clint,Demetrius,Dwarf,Elliott,Emily,Evelyn,George,Gus,Haley,Harvey,Jas,Jodi,Kent,Leah,Lewis,Linus,Marnie,Maru,Pam,Penny,Pierre,Robin,Sam,Sandy,Sebastian,Shane,Vincent,Wizard |dislike=Krobus,Leo,Willy }} ==Bundles== Banana Pudding is not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Recipes== Banana Pudding is not used in any recipes. ==Tailoring== Banana Pudding is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create a {{Name|Banana Shirt|link=Tailoring{{!}}Banana Shirt|class=inline}}. It is a yellow dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. It can be placed in the yellow dye pot at [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]], for use in [[dyeing]]. ==Quests== Banana Pudding is not used in any [[quests]]. ==History== {{History|1.5|Introduced.}} {{NavboxRecipes}} [[Category:Recipes]] [[Category:Cooking]] [[de:Bananenpudding]] [[es:Pudding de plátano]] [[fr:Pudding à la banane]] [[it:Budino di banana]] [[ja:バナナプリン]] [[ko:바나나 푸딩]] [[hu:Banános puding]] [[pt:Pudim de Banana]] [[ru:Банановый пудинг]] [[tr:Muzlu Muhallebi]] [[zh:香蕉布丁]]
